# [HAZ-003] Corrupt artifact accepted 003

## Condition

A corrupt artifact is present in the store while consumers treat it as intact.

## Assessment

| Severity | Likelihood | Rationale |
| -------- | ---------- | --------- |
| critical | remote | Corrupt data reaches downstream consumers unnoticed. |

| Field | Type | Multiplicity | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| hazard_id | UUID | 1..1 | identity |
| condition | String | 1..1 | minLength: 1 |
